verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage screens customers and keeps persistent customer records. The pack documents external-identifier lookup and ongoing monitoring configuration, but nothing about reusing a prior passed check across sessions or products in place of a fresh run. Customer lookup and monitoring are adjacent features, not a documented re-verification or reuse flow, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, a person verified once can be recognized and reused across sessions or products — documented re-verification and reuse of a prior passed check instead of forcing a full re-run
